--- title: "Explore" vignette: > %\VignetteIndexEntry{Explore} %\VignetteEngine{quarto::html} %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8} --- Interactive exemplars for the three chart families the project uses: **time series**, **2D**, and **3D**. Each reads a pipeline target, so the input → chart lineage is explicit. The default stack is R htmlwidgets (`plotly`, `ggiraph`); Observable JS is reserved for bespoke explorables (a later addition). ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} picks <- tar_read(picks) |> filter(year >= 2013, !is.na(height), !is.na(weight), !is.na(overall)) ``` ::: ## Time series — drafts per year ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} viz_drafts_by_season(tar_read(model_table)) ``` ::: {#fig-timeseries .cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ## 2D — draft capital vs. physicals (hover for player) Each point is a drafted player; hover for the name. Color encodes draft round. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} viz_scatter_2d( dplyr::slice_sample(picks, n = min(1500, nrow(picks))), x = weight, y = height, tooltip = name, color = round ) ``` ::: {#fig-2d .cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ## 3D — height × weight × overall pick ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} viz_scatter_3d( picks, x = "height", y = "weight", z = "overall", color = "round" ) ``` ::: {#fig-3d .cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ## NFL outcomes — how long drafted players last Each point is a drafted player bridged to nflverse (decision 0014), placed by draft round against the number of distinct **seasons they spent on an NFL roster** — the project's primary longevity measure. The **#1 overall picks** are highlighted against the rest of the field; the grey bar marks each round's median. Hover for the player. Recent draft classes are still active, so their counts are **right-censored** lower bounds. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} viz_nfl_roster_seasons_by_round(tar_read(picks_nfl), tar_read(nfl_rosters)) ``` ::: {#fig-nfl-longevity .cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ## Player dossier `player_dossier()` resolves a player's scattered rows into one **interpreted** record (decision 0019) rather than a raw extract that is easy to misread. Each dossier shows: identity and physicals; college statistics grouped and labeled by game **phase** (offense / defense / special teams); per-season coaching context; name-guarded high-school recruiting; the NFL outcome (drafted or undrafted-signed) with longevity; and a provenance / caveats block. Below are the **#1 overall picks of the past five NFL drafts**, each rendered as an interpreted dossier. Notes: - A bare `TD` in the long `player_stats` is ambiguous, so stats are relabelled by phase (e.g. "Passing touchdowns" vs "Defensive touchdowns"). - A blank coach cell is shown as "head coach not available" — the CFBD coaches feed is FBS head coaches only, so a non-FBS season (e.g. Cam Ward's 2021 FCS year at Incarnate Word) is flagged, not silently dropped. - Recruiting is name-guarded (decision 0013);
